items.fromString:
h3. Symptom

On Azure, when attempting to deploy a MachinePool into a resourceGroup that is *not* the default ({{{}$infraID-rg{}}}), MachinePool reconciliation {*}succeeds{*}, but the resulting MachineSet {*}breaks{*}, reporting status back up to the MachinePool like:
{noformat}
  - errorMessage: |
      failed to reconcile machine "azr-we-bbc03-lab-xsncf-prueba-westeurope1-gz5t6": failed to create vm azr-we-bbc03-lab-xsncf-prueba-westeurope1-gz5t6: failed to create VM: cannot create vm: PUT https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/2b915b95-8688-4d20-b8d4-69ee608a9468/resourceGroups/azr-we-rg-be-bbc03-lab-001/providers/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/azr-we-bbc03-lab-xsncf-prueba-westeurope1-gz5t6
      --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      RESPONSE 403: 403 Forbidden
      ERROR CODE: LinkedAuthorizationFailed
      --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      {
        "error": {
          "code": "LinkedAuthorizationFailed",
          "message": "The client 'd3ee98d5-bce2-4ca3-9ab7-7bfb392512ff' with object id '0c61c156-b7c0-4208-84d8-a1383309911c' has permission to perform action 'Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/write' on scope '/subscriptions/2b915b95-8688-4d20-b8d4-69ee608a9468/resourceGroups/azr-we-rg-be-bbc03-lab-001/providers/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/azr-we-bbc03-lab-xsncf-prueba-westeurope1-gz5t6'; however, it does not have permission to perform action(s) 'Microsoft.Compute/galleries/images/versions/read' on the linked scope(s) '/subscriptions/2b915b95-8688-4d20-b8d4-69ee608a9468/resourceGroups/azr-we-bbc03-lab-xsncf-rg/providers/Microsoft.Compute/galleries/gallery_azr_we_bbc03_lab_xsncf/images/azr-we-bbc03-lab-xsncf/versions/latest' (respectively) or the linked scope(s) are invalid."
        }
      }
      --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    errorReason: InvalidConfiguration
    maxReplicas: 1
    minReplicas: 1
    name: azr-we-bbc03-lab-xsncf-prueba-westeurope1
    replicas: 1
{noformat}
What's relevant here is that the resourceGroup part of the "linked scope" – {{azr-we-bbc03-lab-xsncf-rg}} here – is the constructed default ({{{}$infraID-rg{}}}) rather than what's configured in the CD.spec.clusterMetadata.platform.azure.resourceGroupName – {{azr-we-rg-be-bbc03-lab-001}} in this case. That RG doesn't exist => kaboom.
h3. Cause

During a hive revendor of installer, azure e2e started failing because the upstream code started using a different path to default the RHCOS VM image (hereinafter: image) returned by the installer code when the marketplace OSImage input was omitted. Patrick pushed a fix that would cause that path to use an empty image because machine-api-operator (hereinafter MAO) on the spoke knows how to default it.

However, MAO on OCP earlier than 4.21 defaults to a "gallery image" by constructing a {{resourceID}} based on the *default resourceGroupName* ({{{}$infraID-rg{}}}). This breaks if no such RG exists, or if the desired image only lives in some other RG, despite that RG name being present in the MachineSet. (On 4.21+ it discovers a "marketplace image" and *does* honor the custom RG if present.)
h3. Workarounds and Fixes
h4. Workaround: Don't use hive MachinePools

Customer creates MachineSets directly on the spoke. They would need to populate {{.spec.template.spec.providerSpec.value.image.resourceID}} explicitly.

👍 No code changes.
👎 It sucks to tell customers not to use a shiny feature.
h4. Workaround: Use "Marketplace" via OSImage

Having the customer provide [OSImage|https://github.com/openshift/hive/blob/fe033076489b3f4279717f1fac664207d3e58d13/vendor/github.com/openshift/hive/apis/hive/v1/azure/machinepool.go#L62] in their MachinePool causes both installer code and MAO to take totally different code paths, and should Just Work™.

👍 No code changes.
👎 Customer responsible for creating marketplace image. IDK what this entails, or if it's even possible. *TBD*
h4. Fix: Make MAO honor custom RGs in <=4.21

We should definitely do this regardless.

👍 Correct fix.
👎 Only available in OCP versions GAed after the fix lands.
 - Long wait
 - Customers may be leery of moving to too-new releases => longer wait
 - The matrix of affected/fixed ACM/MCE/hive+OCP versions is Complicated™ – poor support people 🙁

h4. Fix: Hive discovers and defaults image

...iff OSImage is unset.
We would probably do this by querying existing worker MachineSets and culling the value from their {{{}.spec.template.spec.providerSpec.value.image{}}} (which may be a marketplace *or* gallery image -- either is fine). This is fragile because we have to be looking at a "good" MachineSet – how do we determine that? Can we count on something like {{.status.readyReplicas}} or {{{}.availableReplicas{}}}?

👍 Nice UX: default happens without the customer having to know/do anything special.
👎 Nontrivial code change and concomitant test/support surface.
h4. Fix: Hive grows knob for customer to override resourceID

Add a {{ResourceID}} field to the [Azure-specific MachinePool API|https://github.com/openshift/hive/blob/fe033076489b3f4279717f1fac664207d3e58d13/vendor/github.com/openshift/hive/apis/hive/v1/azure/machinepool.go#L5].

👍 Very simple hive code change.
👎 Customer has to fill this in.
 - They have to learn/know what it is and how to discover it.
 - If they don't think of it ahead of time, they'll have to destroy and recreate the whole MachinePool because we don't allow platform updates for $reasons.

h3. References
 - [Thread|https://redhat-internal.slack.com/archives/C68TNFWA2/p1773332829476699] with [~accountid:70121:80c315bf-36b5-4fb6-849d-46d7d4a3fb9c] discussing what happens where and brainstorming resolutions.
 - [Thread|https://redhat-internal.slack.com/archives/CE3ETN3J8/p1773062116928729] around [case 04394961|https://access.redhat.com/support/cases/04394961]
 - [Thread|https://redhat-internal.slack.com/archives/CE3ETN3J8/p1771606309250579] about a different case (link TBD?)
 - [Hive revendors installer|https://github.com/openshift/hive/pull/2796], triggering azure CI failures, resulting in [this installer fix|https://github.com/openshift/installer/pull/10159] to let MAO default the image.
 - [Thread|https://redhat-internal.slack.com/archives/C68TNFWA2/p1765413518649789] discussing the above.

We would probably do this by querying existing worker MachineSets and culling the value from their {{.spec.template.spec.providerSpec.value.image}} (which may be a marketplace *or* gallery image – either is fine). This is fragile because we have to be looking at a "good" MachineSet – how do we determine that? Can we count on something like {{.status.readyReplicas}} or {{{}.availableReplicas{}}}?

👍 Nice UX: default happens without the customer having to know/do anything special.
👎 Nontrivial code change and concomitant test/support surface.

h4. Fix: Installer code discovers and defaults image

Basically ditto above, but upstream in the installer code that hive vendors.

👎 Customer has to fill this in.
